runtimeLodOverlay.notes: Whole-site skyline retains principal halls,courts,terraces,moats,corridor,double-roof pavilion and six larger precinct gates;small annexes and five other precinct gates reappear in district. District retains every mapped precinct gate as a solid mass. Street restores two-segment arches and6m corridor bays;source/closeup retain all earlier detailed groups plus new8-segment arches and4m bays. Palace/north/vault/altar street detail uses district recipes to fit the whole-site16k budget. Errors are visualization allowances,not measured survey deviations. Remote floors cover the same thirteen openings;the causeway uses the same deck profile at every level. Bounded cutouts are clipped to each resident model tile.

terrainReference.basis: Approximate site fit from retained standard viewer PMTiles and DEM plus ordinary exterior pictures. Native+X is east,+Z south;fixed heading0 and the main hall footprint center define the pose. NativeY0 is the original DEM sample at that anchor,not a surveyed floor. Thirteen separately covered ground pockets preserve the park between groups. The building-only mask preserves independent mapped buildings,including attached shared edges. Host terrain data must resolve the same reference coordinate;architectural floor grades,gate forms,wall routes and exact facing remain visualization estimates.

Explicit occupancy mask for the authored68 mapped buildings and their courts. A single simple building-only polygon connects separate components with narrow strips;these are mask topology,not physical structures or terrain openings. A3cm outside edge allowance avoids numerical procedural slivers after world-coordinate transforms. All784 independent retained map buildings are subtracted from this mask and remain unchanged. Two quantized shared-edge slivers,totaling0.1802m²,are retained for their attached independent neighbors. The whole-park boundary is never used.
